messages.author: Holden Paz
messages.body:
Hello everyone,
I saw a message from Cody Lance Covington from around eight years ago asking about multiple solvation regions: http://archive.ambermd.org/201509/0412.html
Have there been any developments since then regarding multiple solvation regions or a change in the shape of the A and T regions (ellipsoidal rather than spherical)?
Holden
